q4_monocoque_path_mapping.first_uncertified_step: The FIRST uncertified step is step 3's cut(loft skin, loft cavity) on the two spline-section lofts: the swept x swept (loft x loft) boolean pair. The landed restricted-pair solver (ssi4/BIE-002) admits only CircularSweep and Plane/Sphere/Cylinder restricted carriers (its fixtures are sweep x plane / sweep x sweep circular-section sweeps); patch_admit/certified_map admit a single spline carrier, ssi_admit admits spline x plane only, and the spline x spline square-system engine (ssi.rs) + CTE cascade are landed but never wired to two lofted BSplineSurface solids through the funnel (no landed test drives such a pair end to end). The shapeops lift (sweep_lift/classify_from_cells) seeds arrangement cells only for SpineFrameSurface sweeps, not general spline-loft faces, and the splitter itself refuses the deferred certified loci (ValidatedBranchCover/Tangency) today, so step 5's split tier is fully landed only for the analytic-FF / restricted loci it already consumes. So today the facade answers cut(swept,swept) with the typed NonCanonicalCarrier refusal (OP cell 3), exactly the 'loft x loft deep end' named in TT_MODEL_CODEPATH_AUDIT. Steps 1 (loft authoring) and 2 (broadphase) are landed; step 4 (swept x canonical fuses) has all its arms landed in isolation (CFP-004 implicit2d, ssi_admit, canonical closed forms) but depends on the same missing end-to-end certified boolean entry.
